request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and reflective, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, ballad, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What did you go out to see
A reed shaken by the wind
Or a man in soft clothes
Found in royal palaces

[Chorus]
More than a prophet he was
The messenger sent ahead
Preparing the way for us
Among the born of women
None is greater than John

[Verse]
Yet the least in the kingdom
Is greater than he
This generation is like children
Sitting in the marketplace

[Chorus]
More than a prophet he was
The messenger sent ahead
Preparing the way for us
Among the born of women
None is greater than John

[Verse]
We played the flute for you
But you did not dance
We sang a dirge for you
But you did not weep

[Chorus]
More than a prophet he was
The messenger sent ahead
Preparing the way for us
Among the born of women
None is greater than John

[Bridge]
John came without wine or bread
You called him a demon
The Son of Man came eating
You called him a drunkard

[Outro]
But wisdom is vindicated
By all her children
